block.toms_storage.trim.description: Connects inventories with the Inventory Connector.
block.toms_storage.inventory_connector.d: Connects all of the touching inventories into one. Use the Storage Terminal to access all of your items. Trims can connect the gaps.
block.toms_storage.crafting_terminal.des: Gives access to your items. Place it on an inventory. Has a builtin crafting table.
block.toms_storage.storage_terminal.desc: Gives access to your items. Place it on an inventory.
